book.name: 2 TESALONICENSES
book.title: ISCAB CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY TESALÓNICA

content: Hanin Pablo intiꞌan yeb juẍta Silvano yebpaxo juẍta Timoteo chijatojan̈ huneꞌ carta tiꞌ teyet hex ayexxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo bey yul con̈ob Tesalónica, hex hunxa heye yin̈ Comam Dios yeb yin̈ Comam Jesucristo.
Yakꞌabayo Comam Dios yeb Comam Jesucristo iscꞌulchꞌanil iscꞌul yeb akꞌancꞌulal texol hesunil.
Chiilchati sunil anma yin̈ ismul yu Comam Dios yet chul Comam Jesucristo yet iscayelal

Hex wuẍtaj hex wanab, caw yilal chijakꞌan̈ yuchꞌandiosal tet Comam Dios teyin̈, hacaꞌ caw yehi yuto hunun tzꞌayic ischꞌib heyanico heyanma yin̈ Comam Dios, yebpaxo xin caw ecꞌbalto chexahann̈e heba hununex.

Yuxin caw chitzala janmahan̈ chijalnihan̈ hecꞌulal xol hunun majan macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo, yuto caw niman hecꞌul, cheyanipaxico heyanma yin̈ Comam Dios, waxan̈ca xin caw chextzumbelaxicꞌoj cat heyetalaxi.
Haꞌ ton tiꞌ chihalniloj tato chil Comam yin̈ caw istoholal yin̈ tzet chielico anma, cat yalni Comam teyet tato ay heyoc yin̈ bay chioc Comam yahawiloj, yuto lan̈an heyetan heyanma tinan̈.
Wal xin caw haꞌ istoholal chiswatxꞌe Comam Dios, yuxin yilal yanayo Comam isyaꞌtajil yiban̈ huntekꞌan anma chiakꞌni ecꞌoyaꞌ heyanma.

Hex lan̈an heyaben isyaꞌtajil tinan̈, chexyikꞌalo Comam Dios xol isyaꞌtajil tuꞌ jintajan̈ yet chitit Comam Jesucristo yul satcan̈ yeb ebnaj ángel caw aycano yip. Chul Comam xol kꞌa kꞌaꞌ yakꞌaꞌ isyaꞌtajil tet anma mach chisje yohtan̈elo Comam Dios, anma mach chiyoche yabeꞌ istzotiꞌal colbanile aycano yu Comam Jesucristo.
Chialaxcanto anma tuꞌ yin̈ isyaꞌtajil yin̈ huneln̈e, cat yilaxilo sata Comam Dios, hac tuꞌ xin matxa bakꞌinal chiyil anma tuꞌ iscꞌulal Comam yeb yip Comam.

Hayet huneꞌ tzꞌayical yet chihul Comam tuꞌ, caw niman yelapno ye Comam yul sat macta yetxa Comam yehi, yeb mac xayayto yul yanma yin̈ Comam. Xol mac tuꞌ xin ayexico hex tiꞌ, yuto heyaco heyanma yin̈ huneꞌ tzotiꞌ halbilcano juhan̈.

Yuxinto caw chon̈txahlihan̈ teyin̈, chicokꞌannihan̈ tet Comam Dios haxinwal caw cꞌulex yul sat, ay heyoc yin̈ yawtebal Comam. Chijalnipaxojan̈ ta chakꞌ Comam yip teyet hewatxꞌen sunil iscꞌulal choche hecꞌul, yeb yin̈ munil chewatxꞌe tet Comam, yuto ayco heyanma yin̈ Comam.
Hac tuꞌ xin chialaxico ismay Comam Jesucristo heyu. Chialaxpaxico hewinajil yu iscꞌulal Comam Dios yeb xin Comam Jesucristo.
